profile.headline: Game Designer
profile.summary:
I have an Associate of Science degree in Computer Science from Del Tech, as well as a Bachelor of Science degree in Game Design & Development from Wilmington University.

I love working on games and interacting with all aspects of game design, with most of my experience being in Unity development and programming.  I worked as a technical designer for QuadraTron Games on the game FishHeads which is an infinite runner currently released on iOS, Android, Apple TV, and Steam.  And I'm currently working on the QuadraTron team as the lead technical designer for two other projects.

I'm currently looking for game design or Unity development jobs.  If you want to check out some of my projects have a look at my portfolium page here: https://portfolium.com/EricArnold7/portfolio

Thanks for reading, and have a great day.

positions.title: Lead Technical Designer
positions.locationName: New Castle County, Delaware, United States
positions.description:
Currently working on two games with team QuadraTron.  A sci-fi themed run and gun, and a fantasy themed dungeon crawler.

As lead technical designer I work on many pieces of core functionality in both games, as well as assist the project lead in reviewing code and project changes made by other technical designers.
